AGREEMENT FOR SALE (DEMO - FICTIONAL)
This Agreement for Sale is made at Greater Noida on 2nd May 2018 between Arvant Infra Private Limited, a
company incorporated under the Companies Act, 2013 (the 'Promoter'), and Ms. Ananya Mehra (the
'Allottee').
The Promoter is developing the project known as Skyline Residency, registered with the Real Estate
Regulatory Authority under registration number UPRERAPRJ-DEMO-0417.
1.1 The Promoter agrees to sell and the Allottee agrees to purchase Apartment No. C-1204 on the twelfth
floor of Tower C, having a carpet area of 1,450 square feet.
1.2 The Total Price of the Apartment is Rs. 72,00,000/- (Rupees Seventy-Two Lakh only), payable as per the
construction-linked plan in Schedule C.

7. POSSESSION OF THE APARTMENT
7.1 The Promoter shall hand over possession of the Apartment to the Allottee on or before 30th June 2021,
unless there is delay due to force majeure as defined in clause 9.
7.2 If the Promoter fails to hand over possession by the date in clause 7.1, the Promoter shall pay the Allottee
compensation at Rs. 5/- per square foot of carpet area per month for the period of delay.
7.3 The Allottee shall take possession within two months of the written offer of possession, failing which
holding charges shall apply.

judge.reasoning: The buyer has claimed delay possession charges since the promoter failed to hand over possession within the stipulated period under the agreement and is continuing with the project. As established in the precedents, where an allottee does not intend to withdraw from the project, they are entitled to interest for every month of delay under Section 18 of the Act read with Rule 15 of the Rules. The builder is also entitled to a force majeure extension of 6 months due to the outbreak of Covid-19 under the applicable notification for projects. Furthermore, the promoter is prohibited from charging anything from the complainants that is not a part of the agreement. Therefore, the complaint is partly allowed regarding the claim for delay possession charges and the restriction on extra charges, subject to any necessary adjustments.

weak_points.fix: The buyer should recalculate the due date of possession by adding the 6-month extension as supported by the precedents.
weak_points.title: Failure to account for force majeure extension
weak_points.detail: The buyer calculates delay from the original promised date without incorporating the 6-month Covid-19 force majeure extension granted to the project.

weak_points.fix: The buyer can align their claims explicitly with Rule 15 and settled relief structures as seen in prior orders.
weak_points.title: Incomplete quantification of relief parameters
weak_points.detail: The buyer relies broadly on statutory provisions without specifying the exact rate or precise timelines applicable under the rules.
